strategies.name: ict_stop_raid_mss_retracement_pd_array_entry
strategies.entry_summary: After forming a daily bias, wait for a stop raid/liquidity sweep, then a market structure shift/displacement in the intended direction. Enter on the retracement into discount/premium or OTE, using a PD array such as a fair value gap, order block, breaker block, or box overlap as the entry location.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the invalidation low/high of the chosen PD array or swing. Take a first partial at opposing liquidity or prior highs/lows, then either move stop to breakeven and hold for further liquidity, or target the next liquidity pool/new high or low.

variants.target_note: first partial at buy-side liquidity, then optional breakeven management for further upside

strategies.name: ict_box_setup_deviation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade a box/deviation setup by identifying a range, waiting for price to deviate below or above it and then reclaim the range. Enter on the retest of the manipulation/deviation area, aiming for price to travel to the opposite side of the range.
strategies.exit_summary: Take partials as price moves toward the other side of the range and opposing liquidity; the example implies scaling out into highs above the range rather than using a fixed R target.

variants.variant_label: Bullish deviation below range then reclaim and retest
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: after deviation below the range and aggressive reclaim, wait for retest of the manipulation zone before entering long
variants.target_note: take partials and aim for liquidity resting above / the other side of the range
variants.transcript_quote: I want to see distribution so ideally I'm looking for a retest of this manipulation to then be reaching for the other side here before going higher

result.enumeration_note: The main checklist examples share one retracement-after-stop-raid-and-structure-shift skeleton with PD-array/OTE configuration changes, so they are grouped as one strategy with variants; the separate box setup is oppositional in entry logic and is enumerated separately.
